setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Doll** (2 reviews): Reviewer was moved to tears by this version; Reviewer loved China Doll emerging from Space, calling it a beautiful version [18][21]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): At the end, Phil drops a bomb so low in frequency you must listen closely [22]
- **Never Trust A Woman** (1 review): Jerry kept this one tightly controlled [20]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Reviewer felt Jerry's solo sounded like lead playing for a different song [20]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Jerry's soloing was gentle and beautiful throughout the night, especially here [20]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer found the Deal so intense it left them trembling [18]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Second-set opener sent the whole crowd wild; the main thing this first-timer remembers [26]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The jam transition into Fire is described as unforgettable [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-04-09.140872.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 137 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-04-09.sbd-mtx.miller.90477.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader calls this Ultra Matrix mix very poor sounding [2]
- **gd1987-04-09.170625.nak300.mc.levitt.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd87-04-09.schoeps.eD.11657.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 131 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Better of the two audience recordings; reviewer knows of no soundboard for this show; Muted, especially in the highs; Jerry sits lower in the mix, while the low end and Bobby's guitar are stronger [23][25]
- **gd1987-04-09.170624.nak300.mc.levitt.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 130 min [6]
- **gd87-04-09.aud.braverman.10262.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 130 min; rated 4.1/5 by 10 [9]. Said about its sound: Good audience recording that captures the crowd's energy and stomping [22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had seen three Dead shows before Jerry's coma; this night felt like a new level of blissful concert experience [17]
- Smallest venue the reviewer ever saw the band in; Jerry brought strong energy so soon after his coma [18]
- UIC Pavilion felt small for an arena; reviewer's first show after Jerry's return [21]
- Reviewer sat near the back of the arena with girlfriend and school friends; everyone planned to return next night [26]
- Reviewer took their fiancé to these shows and rode Chicago's El for three days [27]
- Reviewer took their fiancé to these shows and rode Chicago's El for three days [28]
- Levitt's tape collection was rescued from a storage shed in New Jersey after years of storage [6]
- Reviewer ranks the Scarlet-Fire pairing among the best of 1987 [21]
- Second set rated among the best of 1987, with exceptionally tight playing [23]
- Lesser than the other audience recording, which has crisper highs and Jerry louder, as heard in the house [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-04-09.140872.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]
- **gd1987-04-09.sbd-mtx.miller.90477.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D6/Maxell XLII-S90/Dolby C) [2]. Also: Matrix made from cassettes supplied by Steve Marcus [2]
- **gd1987-04-09.170625.nak300.mc.levitt.flac2496**: taped by Barry Levitt; transferred by Mark Goldey; source: 2x Nak 300 CP4 + 1x Nak 300 (center) > unknown mixer > Nak 550 [4]. Also: Taped by Barry Levitt on Nakamichi 300 gear; from his collection, saved by his ex Liza; Tape unheard for nearly 30 years; patched and pitch corrected against another circulating source [4]
- **gd87-04-09.schoeps.eD.11657.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by MC>DAT>CDR via Billy Sunday; Seeded to etree by eD(efojr); source: FOB>Schoeps CMC 441Âs w/hyper Cardioid>MC [5]. Also: Reviewer's old, poorer-sounding cassette of the show may descend from this recording [25]
- **gd1987-04-09.170624.nak300.mc.levitt.flac1644**: taped by Barry Levitt; transferred by mgoldey; source: 2x Nak 300 CP4 + 1x Nak 300 (center) > unknown mixer > Nak 550 [6]. Also: Transferred from cassette through a Nak Dragon to Tascam DA-3000 DSF, converted to PCM, then mastered in Wavelab 12 [6]
- **gd87-04-09.aud.braverman.10262.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience cassette (Nakamichi 300/Sony D5) [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-04-09 UIC Pavilion, Chicago, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-04-09-uic-pavilion-chicago-il-usa/) [30]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-04-11 UIC Pavilion, Chicago, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-04-11-uic-pavilion-chicago-il-usa/) [31]
- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Grateful Dead 4/9/1987 Chicago Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_870409.html) [32]
